findings.title: 13 moderate vulnerabilities in @opentelemetry/* via @grafana/faro-web-tracing <=2.7.1
findings.detail: GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf: OpenTelemetry Core unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation (CVE CVSS 5.3). Affects @opentelemetry/core <2.8.0 and all transitive dependents (@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base, @opentelemetry/otlp-transformer, etc.). Root cause is @grafana/faro-web-sdk and @grafana/faro-web-tracing pinned at ^2.4.0; upgrading to ^2.8.2 pulls in @opentelemetry/core 2.8.x which is patched. Severity is moderate (not high/critical) but fix is low-risk minor-version upgrade.
findings.suggested_fix: Bump @grafana/faro-web-sdk and @grafana/faro-web-tracing from ^2.4.0 to ^2.8.2 in package.json and run npm install

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18.3.1 installed, 19.2.7 available)
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom at ^18.3.1; npm outdated reports latest is 19.2.7. React 19 is a major version with breaking changes (concurrent features, new hooks API surface). Not safe to upgrade without review and testing.
findings.suggested_fix: Manually review React 19 migration guide, update @types/react and @types/react-dom alongside react and react-dom, then bump to ^19.0.0 in package.json

findings.title: All recent main-branch CI runs show conclusion: skipped
findings.detail: Last 5 runs of the Claude Code workflow on main branch all have conclusion=skipped. This appears to be expected: the Claude Code workflow has PR-only triggers. Claude Code Review and Release workflows succeed on their respective branches. No actual test/build failures detected.
findings.suggested_fix: No action required; skipped status is expected for PR-gated workflows on direct pushes to main
